mapper.select: select count(distinct `order`.id) as paidOrderCount, count(distinct `order`.member_id) as participantCount, ifnull(sum(order_item.total_price), 0) as salesAmount, ifnull(( select sum(sku.stock) from s_seckill_sku sku where sku.deleted = 0 and sku.activity_id = #{activityId} ), 0) as remainingStock from s_order `order` inner join s_order_item order_item on order_item.order_id = `order`.id and order_item.deleted = 0 inner join s_seckill_spu spu on spu.id = order_item.spu_id and spu.deleted = 0 where `order`.deleted = 0 and `order`.order_type = '2' and `order`.pay_success_time is not null and `order`.status not in ('5', '6', '7') and spu.activity_id = #{activityId}

select spu.id as seckillSpuId, spu.name, ifnull(( select sum(order_item.quantity) from s_order_item order_item inner join s_order `order` on `order`.id = order_item.order_id and `order`.deleted = 0 where order_item.deleted = 0 and order_item.spu_id = spu.id and `order`.order_type = '2' and `order`.pay_success_time is not null and `order`.status not in ('5', '6', '7') ), 0) as salesCount, ifnull(( select sum(order_item.total_price) from s_order_item order_item inner join s_order `order` on `order`.id = order_item.order_id and `order`.deleted = 0 where order_item.deleted = 0 and order_item.spu_id = spu.id and `order`.order_type = '2' and `order`.pay_success_time is not null and `order`.status not in ('5', '6', '7') ), 0) as salesAmount, ifnull(( select sum(sku.stock) from s_seckill_sku sku where sku.deleted = 0 and sku.seckill_spu_id = spu.id ), 0) as remainingStock from s_seckill_spu spu where spu.deleted = 0 and spu.activity_id = #{activityId} and spu.audit_status = 2 order by salesAmount desc, salesCount desc, spu.id desc
